description: Roentgenium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Rg and atomic number 111. It is extremely radioactive and can only be created in a laboratory. It is a d-block transactinide element and member of the 7th period, placed in group 11 elements.
uses: Roentgenium has no practical application. Only a few roentgenium atoms have ever been synthesized.
characteristics: The most stable known isotope, roentgenium-282, has a half-life of 100 seconds. Roentgenium is predicted to be a solid metal with a density around 22-24 g/cm³ and is calculated to have similar properties to its lighter homologues copper, silver, and gold, though it may show some differences from them.
